title: Selection and reselection of NR sidelink U2N Relay UE

entities.name: U2N Remote UE
entities.description: A UE capable of NR sidelink U2N Remote UE operation that is configured by upper layers to search for a NR sidelink U2N Relay UE.

entities.name: U2N Relay UE
entities.description: A relay UE that provides connectivity to the network for U2N Remote UEs via NR sidelink.

entities.name: No suitable cell condition
entities.description: Condition where the UE has no suitable cell to camp on.

entities.name: Low cell RSRP condition
entities.description: Condition where RSRP measurement of the camping cell/PCell is below threshHighRemote within sl-remoteUE-Config.

entities.name: No selected relay condition
entities.description: Condition where the UE does not have a selected NR sidelink U2N Relay UE.

entities.name: Low SL-RSRP condition
entities.description: Condition where SL-RSRP of currently selected relay UE is below sl-RSRP-Thresh.

entities.name: Low SD-RSRP condition
entities.description: Condition where SD-RSRP of currently selected relay UE is below sl-RSRP-Thresh when SL-RSRP is not available.

entities.name: Upper layer rejection condition
entities.description: Condition where upper layers indicate not to use the currently selected relay UE.

entities.name: PC5-RRC connection release condition
entities.description: Condition where upper layers request release or AS layer releases the PC5-RRC connection with the currently selected relay UE.

entities.name: Sidelink radio link failure condition
entities.description: Condition where sidelink radio link failure is detected on the PC5-RRC connection with the current relay UE.

entities.name: NR sidelink discovery procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed to search for candidate NR sidelink U2N Relay UEs as specified in clause 5.8.13.

entities.name: Relay selection procedure
entities.description: Procedure to select a candidate NR sidelink U2N Relay UE based on SD-RSRP measurements and filtering.

entities.name: No relay selected outcome
entities.description: Outcome when UE did not detect any candidate relay UE which SD-RSRP exceeds sl-RSRP-Thresh by sl-HystMin.

relations.description: UE performs relay search when it has no suitable cell.
UE performs relay search when cell RSRP is below threshold.
UE performs relay search when it has no selected relay UE.
UE performs relay search when SL-RSRP of current relay is below threshold.
UE performs relay search when SD-RSRP of current relay is below threshold.
UE performs relay search when upper layers reject current relay.
UE performs relay search when PC5-RRC connection is released.
UE performs relay search when sidelink radio link failure occurs.
UE performs NR sidelink discovery procedure to search for candidate relay UEs.
UE performs relay selection procedure to evaluate and select candidate relay UEs.
Relay selection procedure establishes connection with a suitable U2N Relay UE.
Relay selection procedure may result in no relay being selected if no suitable candidates found.
